title: R2 dashboard SSE event DTO
description: Shape of one event delivered over the Server-Sent Events channel at GET /api/stream (design.md Q3: SSE chosen over WebSocket because traffic is server->client only). This schema validates the JSON carried in the SSE frame's `data:` field. The SSE frame itself adds transport metadata: `event: <type>` (the topic, mirrored in `type` below), `id: <seq>` (monotonic per-connection sequence), and for heartbeats a bare `: ping` comment line. v1 has NO server-side replay of missed events (spec D2.2 fallback): on reconnect the client refetches affected queries. So `seq` is per-connection and resets on reconnect — it is for client-side ordering/dedupe within a single connection, not durable cursoring.

type.description: Event topic, mirrored in the SSE `event:` field. iteration.scored: a new iter-N.score.yaml sidecar appeared (spec R5). session.updated: a session-<id>.score.yaml was rewritten under the same rubric version (spec R6). score.recomputed: an existing iteration score changed in place. rubric.changed: the rubric was recomputed under a NEW version — a broadcast that triggers a full client reload (spec R7). heartbeat: 15s keepalive to defeat proxy idle-timeouts (usually sent as a `: ping` comment, but also valid as a typed event).

seq.description: Monotonic per-connection sequence number, mirrored in the SSE `id:` field. Resets to 0 on a new connection (no durable replay in v1).

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC time the event was published.

payload.description: Event-type-specific body. Keyed identifiers (session_id, iteration) let the client invalidate exactly the affected TanStack Query keys. The payload is intentionally a thin key set, NOT the full DTO — the client refetches the affected resource on receipt.

band.description: New band for the iteration, so the UI can tint a live tick without an immediate refetch.

oneOf.description: rubric.changed payload — triggers a full client reload.
